1.title: Supreme Court Ruling Could Have Limited Impact on Voter Screening in Midterms
1.summary: Federal law requires a 90-day “quiet period” before elections, likely restricting the immediate scope of a decision that allows the use of a citizenship database to examine voter rolls.

2.title: Supreme Court Once Again Blocks Republican-Backed Voting Map in Missouri
2.summary: A federal appeals court had sided with Republicans seeking to use redrawn congressional district boundaries to give their party an advantage in the midterms elections.

3.title: 30 College Students Splattered With Condiments and Liquids in Hazing, Police Say
3.summary: Two University of Wisconsin-Madison students face charges of suspicion of hazing in the episode, which happened on Wednesday in a sweltering basement, officials said.

4.title: OpenAI investigating 'dozens' of instances of agents acting improperly
4.summary: OpenAI agents tried to get information from "governments, universities, public agencies, and other institutions" through extreme means that sometimes curbed security controls, the company said.

5.title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
5.summary: Asked about the Iranian offer, a US official told the BBC "constructive discussions" were taking place through mediators.

6.title: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
6.summary: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.
